item.title: SpaceX acquires xAI as Elon Musk moves to unite rockets, satellites and artificial intelligence
item.description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has acquired xAI in a landmark deal that brings rockets, Starlink satellites, X and the Grok chatbot under one roof ahead of a potential blockbuster IPO later this year. Read more: SpaceX acquires xAI as Elon Musk moves to unite rockets, satellites and artificial intelligence

item.title: FTSE 100 hits record high as dollar rallies and gold extends sharp pullback
item.description: The FTSE 100 closed at a record high as a stronger dollar lifted UK equities, while gold, silver and oil prices fell sharply amid volatile global markets. Read more: FTSE 100 hits record high as dollar rallies and gold extends sharp pullback

item.title: ICO opens formal investigation into Grok AI over data protection and harmful imagery concerns
item.description: The Information Commissioner’s Office has launched formal investigations into X Internet Unlimited Company and X.AI over their handling of personal data in connection with the Grok artificial intelligence system. Read more: ICO opens formal investigation into Grok AI over data protection and harmful imagery concerns

item.title: Hair Syrup founder launches £5,000 ‘Honey Pot’ fund to back UK entrepreneurs
item.description: The founder of viral beauty brand Hair Syrup has launched a new founder-led initiative designed to help early-stage UK entrepreneurs turn ideas into viable businesses. Read more: Hair Syrup founder launches £5,000 ‘Honey Pot’ fund to back UK entrepreneurs

item.title: Barnsley named UK’s first ‘tech town’ as US giants back AI rollout
item.description: Barnsley has been rebranded as the UK’s first “tech town”, with Microsoft, Google, Cisco and Adobe backing a government-led AI rollout across schools, healthcare and local businesses. Read more: Barnsley named UK’s first ‘tech town’ as US giants back AI rollout

item.title: One million miss HMRC tax return deadline as penalties begin
item.description: Around one million taxpayers missed the HMRC self-assessment deadline, triggering automatic £100 fines and potential interest charges for late filers. Read more: One million miss HMRC tax return deadline as penalties begin

item.title: Government issues new guidance to help businesses prepare for employment law changes
item.description: The Government has launched new guidance to help UK employers prepare for employment law reforms taking effect from April under the Employment Rights Act 2025. Read more: Government issues new guidance to help businesses prepare for employment law changes

item.title: Timur Yusufov on Building Systems That Support People
item.description: Timur Yusufov is a business leader whose career sits at the crossroads of real estate, healthcare, and long-term community design. Born in the former Soviet Union, he moved to the United States in 1992. That early experience shaped how he thinks about stability, systems, and opportunity. Read more: Timur Yusufov on Building Systems That Support People

item.title: Stop watching Netflix and go to the pub, Welsh first minister tells public
item.description: Welsh first minister Eluned Morgan has urged people to stop watching Netflix and go to the pub as Wales unveils a one-year business rates discount for hospitality. Read more: Stop watching Netflix and go to the pub, Welsh first minister tells public

item.title: EU has ‘open mind’ on UK customs union talks, commissioner says
item.description: Brussels is open to discussing closer trade ties with the UK, including a customs union, as EU commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis signals willingness to re-engage. Read more: EU has ‘open mind’ on UK customs union talks, commissioner says
